$meta.note: The [PAT-1] registry-as-data ([docs/Weft-RV_科研目标总纲v2.md] §2.8:118). Each row is {pattern_id, requires, transform, mechanism, metrics_hook, status ∈ {mechanized|partial|planned|measured-negative|deferred-backlog}}. This is EVIDENCE-axis mirror data (core-invariants I4): it never chooses route/compute/dtype; it records which construction patterns are mechanized and points a lit/metrics artifact at each. A row's status flips planned->partial->mechanized ONLY when its construction primitive lands with a lit artifact hung on metrics_hook. status=measured-negative is a LAYER-4 characterization outcome: the construction primitive IS mechanized (green lit) but a perf/optimization HYPOTHESIS attached to it was measured on hardware and FALSIFIED -- the row records the falsified boundary as a design-space asset, it is NOT a failed or planned brick. status=deferred-backlog is a NAMED salvage/optimization path that is NOT mechanized (no ODS/verifier/emit primitive landed) and is explicitly PARKED with a restart_condition + evidence pointer -- distinct from `planned` (a scheduled brick in the CURRENT milestone): a deferred-backlog row reopens only when a FUTURE campaign reproduces its bottleneck with NEW evidence. Created in the M-FLAT milestone alongside brick 1 (the canon specifies this schema but no file existed).

patterns.mechanism: [XFER-1] S6 transfer rule -- THREE classes, discriminated by whether the format's decode has STAGEABLE strips under HIGH register pressure. UNIFIED CRITERION: S6 applies <=> the hot loop carries HIGH register pressure from STAGEABLE decode strips (the stack-panel can externalize a COLD decoded strip so the HOT accumulator fan-out drops under the <=32-vreg cliff). Observable discriminant (objdump): post-tile maxVreg v30 = crossed <=32 cliff = HOLDS; v31 = cliff NOT reached = NULL; spill->0 = HOLDS, rose/flat = NULL, already <=32 pre-tile = structural no-op.

xfer_classes.requires: dual d/dmin + bsums-min i32 accumulators (fold_model kquant_dmin_bsums_min) AROUND a single-plane nibble/scale decode that IS stageable into the stack-panel; it is the ACCUMULATOR fan-out (not the weight assembly) that overflows 32.
xfer_classes.mechanism: inline-min-fold drops the bsums i32 family + stacks the decoded 6-bit scale/min strip to L1 (cold) -> HOT accumulator fan-out drops under 32 -> spill->0, maxVreg v30. The q4_K register-cliff lever transfers WHOLE to q2_K (single-plane) and q5_K (the qh 5th-bit inject is orthogonal to the tiling; min+bsums fold dominates and crosses the cliff despite the extra qh plane).

xfer_classes.requires: MULTI-PLANE weight assembly (q6_K ql+qh 6-bit dual plane / q3_K qs+hmask 3-bit subtractive) whose ~900+ vand/vsrl/vsll/vor/vsub reconstruction ops (1.28x q6_K / 3.29x q3_K of the dot vwmacc) are NON-stageable: the whole weight strip must be live simultaneously to assemble one int8 weight.
xfer_classes.mechanism: the S6 stack-panel only externalizes the ~84 scale-strip spill = one drop in the ~900 weight-reconstruction bucket; the DOMINANT live set is the multi-plane weight assembly, which the panel cannot touch -> spill stays >>32 (q6_K rose 913->949 / q3_K 978->894), maxVreg v31, NO <=32 cliff. vs-opponent stays ~5.2-5.4x LOSS (weight-bound, not tiling-curable).

xfer_classes.requires: codebook decode via vluxei16 MEMORY gather (weight = codebook[nibble]; vwmacc=0 = ZERO register weight-reconstruction); spill ALREADY <=32 (at the register cliff) pre-tile; NO high-register-pressure stageable decode strip exists.
xfer_classes.mechanism: there is no HIGH-register-pressure stageable strip to externalize -- the codebook body already sits at the <=32-vreg cliff (iq4_nl spill 7/v30; iq4_xs spill 73/v30), so S6 output tiling is a STRUCTURAL NO-OP: the front-door body ships PLAIN/untiled, byte-exact to the retired direct-emitter body verbatim.
